name: bob-chat
description: BoB Chat — Connect Telegram to your AI: read, search and answer your own Telegram chats from ChatGPT through the BoB Chat app on your phone.

interface.longDescription:
BoB Chat — Connect Telegram to your AI.

Ask ChatGPT "what did I miss in Telegram?", "find the message about the invoice" or "tell Max I'm on my way". ChatGPT reads your unread chats, searches your conversations and, when you ask, sends a reply from your own Telegram account.

It works through the BoB Chat app on your own phone (Android or iPhone). You sign in to Telegram in the app; each request from ChatGPT is relayed to the app, which runs it on the phone and returns the result. In the app you choose what ChatGPT may do: read only or also send, and which kinds of chats it may see (private chats, groups, bots, channels).

ChatGPT acts only as you, only on your own linked accounts. Every message it sends is a separate action you approve. One-time login codes in messages are hidden before they reach ChatGPT.

BoB Chat is an independent product of BoB Tools LLP, not affiliated with or endorsed by Telegram.
capabilities: Send a message as you, after your approval
defaultPrompt: What did I miss in Telegram today?
Find the Telegram message where someone mentioned the invoice
Reply to Max on Telegram: on my way, see you at 3

positive.description: Show the linked Telegram accounts and what the connection may do
positive.prompt: Which Telegram accounts are linked to BoB Chat, and what are you allowed to do with them?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls chat_overview and lists the demo phone with one Telegram account (Bob), saying that reading personal chats, groups and channels and sending are allowed (bot chats are turned off). Nothing is changed and nothing is sent.

positive.prompt: What did I miss in Telegram? Summarise my unread chats.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls chat_unread, then chat_recent for the unread chats, and summarises who wrote and what needs a reply (on the demo account: the chat with Max and the Pavel Durov and Telegram Tips channels). If an earlier test already read everything, it says there is nothing unread. Read-only: messages stay unread.

positive.description: List the chats of the linked account
positive.expected_behavior: Calls chat_list and shows the chats of the linked account with their names and kinds (on the demo account: the private chat with Max and the Pavel Durov and Telegram Tips channels, among others). Read-only: nothing is sent and nothing is marked as read.

positive.description: Read the latest messages of one chat
positive.prompt: Show the last 5 messages in my Telegram chat with Max.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls chat_search_contacts with "Max" to get the accountId and chatId, then chat_recent with unread_only false and limit 5, and shows the newest messages (up to five) with sender and time. Read-only.

positive.description: Send a message as the user, after approval
positive.prompt: Send Max a Telegram message: "On my way, see you at 3."
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Max with chat_search_contacts, shows the text, and calls chat_send only after the user approves the action in ChatGPT. The result is "Message sent." and the message appears in the chat with Max (chat_recent shows it as outgoing). Exactly one message is sent.

negative.description: There is no tool to delete chats or messages: the plugin says it cannot delete and changes nothing
negative.prompt: Delete my whole Telegram chat with Max.

negative.description: Other people's accounts are not accessible: only the chats of the signed-in user's own linked Telegram account are visible
negative.prompt: Show me the private Telegram chats of my colleague Anna from her own account.
Book me a table for two at an Italian restaurant tonight.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.
